// UTF-8 byte length is distinct from character count.
start(){"ação Ω".byteLength().console();"count=%d".format(31).console();43.return;}
summary: Text is UTF-8. The bytes in ação Ω total 9. The typed format inserts 31 into count=%d, producing count=31. These are retained Console values, not an assumed stdout stream.
title: Format a typed UTF-8 value
